notes.title: Pocket Wheels @ Gamescom 2025... time for a demo update! 🆕
notes.notes:
[h3]Pocket Wheels @ Gamescom 2025[/h3]
I'm incredibly happy to announce that [i]Pocket Wheels[/i] is part of this year's Indie Arena Booth Gamescom lineup 🎉 

[b]From August 20 to 24, I will be at the Deck13 Spotlight Indie Arena Booth in Hall 10.2.[/b] 
If you are planning on being there, I would love to chat! 


[h3]For this occasion, the demo's content has been doubled...[/h3]
To make the game more accessible for first-time players, I've added a [b]quick and fun tutorial[/b] that teaches you the basic mechanics in an intuitive way!

Once you've mastered this new section, you're teleported to a [b]small hub world.[/b] 
From there, you can either [b]choose to play the previously available level or venture into an entirely new adventure.[/b] This new level is packed with thrilling races and quests set among wooden floors and lush greenery. There's even a tree house! (trying very hard not to spoil [i]all [/i]the fun exploration here) 

[b]You can play this demo here on Steam and on the show floor at Gamescom.[/b] The show in Cologne will also be the first time you can try out a [b]Nintendo Switch version! [/b]


[h3]...and there's been a MASSIVE boost to our sound design 🚀[/h3]
 Thanks to the efforts of our friends at [url=https://hborgarts.wixsite.com/bowstohymns]BowsToHymns[/url], the game feels much more alive, and it's so satisfying to play! [b]They poured their hearts into the sound design,[/b] making sure that every vehicle is fun to drive and that each pickup feels rewarding. 

You'll notice many improvements as soon as you start playing, so pay close attention to their amazing work!


[h3]Have fun playing & talk to you soon![/h3]
As always, please let me know what you think of the changes! [b]I'm looking forward to meeting you at Gamescom or hearing your thoughts on [i]Pocket Wheels'[/i] [url=https://discord.gg/ZCfbVyD]Discord server[/url] 💛[/b]


[i](A small disclaimer: You might run into an issue if you've played the demo before, which results in an endless loading loop at the beginning. To resolve this, please delete the "Pocket Wheels" folder in "AppData/\LocalLow/\Florian Wolf", and you should be good to go!)
[/i]

notes.title: Celebrating Wholesome Games With A New Demo Update 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Let's celebrate![/h3]
Hey everyone!
I'm thrilled to announce that Pocket Wheels will be participating in the [b]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/b] from today until the 21st of August 🚗

[h3]Because woohoo, the demo received an update...[/h3]
Leading up to this event, [b]I made quite some changes to the demo[/b]. 
This is a very exciting update for me because I feel like every little improvement I have tinkered with over the last few weeks [i]really [/i]adds to the game and makes it a much better experience as a whole. Please check out the changelog below for more details ([strike]except for bug fixes, because there were far too many...[/strike])!

[h3]...and also its own Steam store page![/h3]
Of course, I would love to know what you think of these changes, so I decided to make use of the new Steam feature and created [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983310/]a dedicated store page for the demo.[/url][/b] This way, you will not only be able to leave your feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/ZCfbVyD]Discord server[/url], but also in the review section right here on Steam. 
So if you have a minute or two, [b]feel free to leave a review![/b]

I hope you enjoy this update and where the game's headed. 
[b]Best wishes and have fun playing the demo![/b] 💛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37946837/110e69376c0300ccf429c7da80bbc4fb133095b9.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: New UI that shows collected coins, batteries, and best times.
[*] Added: Option to manually select the controller icons.
[*] Added: Steam Deck support.
[*] Added: New Logo and Endscreen.
[*] Added: Level introduction cutscene.
[*] Improved: The color grading was drastically changed giving the game a more vibrant look.
[*] Improved: Shadows were reworked and now look much better.
[*] Improved: The controls are fine tuned based on player feedback.
[*] Improved: A lot more juice was added to the animations.
[*] Improved: Many more little tweaks for you to find!
[*] Fixed: There were countless bugs since the last version and it would be too much to list all of them. 
[*] Removed: Native Linux support was dropped because Proton just works much better.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983310/Pocket_Wheels_Demo/

notes.title: Pocket Wheels is now playable on Mac & Linux with the new demo update!
notes.notes:
The new Pocket Wheels demo version is out now and it also includes a Mac and Linux version! 
A speedrun timer and an optimized nitro mechanic are some of the new changes. Check out the Website for the full changelog here: https://pocket-wheels.com/changelog/

Come talk about the game or compare your records with us on the Discord server: https://discord.gg/ZCfbVyD
